and replace the old same-Pod socket
run_seq N, history_seq H, frozen model/thinking,

Browser authentication and public Chat transport belong to mate-service.
The browser receives chat_id, never session_id or Runtime credentials.
The bridge maps chat_id to session_id and rebuilds Frames.
Protocol v2 always uses typed structured delta.
Suppressed thinking updates use redacted placeholders.
Request id selects the pending payload decoder.
